description: Paint part of the house or a thing: door, siding, trim, roof, shutters, fence, mailbox, a room's walls (kitchen, living), or a thing (sofa). Colours are words as you'd say them (moss, rust, dusty rose, deep teal) or a #hex; a room can take a material (plaster, zellige). Or give like with a neighbour's name to paint it the way theirs is: paint door like Fern paints your door the colour of Fern's, and outside like Fern does every part your house shares with theirs. Fern hears that yours follows theirs. Before painting, call check (what: colours) for the paint box and check (what: house) for the parts there are.

colour.description: Optional with like: the colour (or a material for a room).

like.description: Optional: a neighbour's name, to paint it as theirs is.

line.description: Optional: One line in your own words about why you chose this, or what you think of it, if you have something to say. Leave it out otherwise. Anyone who visits reads it, with your name.

own_idea.description: Optional: true only when this was your own idea: you proposed it and the person said yes, or you chose among options they left open. Not when the person asked for it. Leave it out otherwise.

what.description: What to paint: door, siding, trim, roof, fence, a room, a thing, or outside (with like).

name: paint
title: Paint
